rationale: Directly assayed with recombinant alpha/beta; ATP-specific, GTP inactive. The term names a reversible reaction and does not assert a physiological direction.
Contradicted by direct assay: no detectable GTP activity (PMID 18452512). Classic paralog/family over-annotation by phylogenetic transfer.

The organism has no complete TCA cycle: citrate synthase, aconitase, isocitrate dehydrogenase and OGDH E1 all absent from UP000078348 and reported absent in PMID 18403202. Rule-based carry-over from mitochondrial SCS.

term: succinyl-CoA metabolic process / succinate metabolic process
rationale: A direction-neutral BP term is the defensible substitute. GO:0006104 succinyl-CoA metabolic process covers the activity without committing to a direction or to the TCA cycle.

term: acetyl-CoA catabolic process / acetate biosynthetic process
rationale: Would assert the ASCT/SCS cycle. Supported by inventory and comparison but not by any Blastocystis flux or genetic evidence; the ADP-forming acetyl-CoA synthetase is an untested competing route.
This is exactly the directional claim the analysis cannot reach. Adding it would infer physiology from pathway context alone.

Localisation to the organelle is experimental. The organelle is explicitly described as intermediate between mitochondrion and hydrogenosome (PMID 18403202); a curator may prefer GO:0005739 mitochondrion or a mitochondrion-related organelle term.
Heterodimer with a beta subunit is supported; the alpha subunit even forms an active enzyme with the P. falciparum beta subunit.
